# Medicality Consultants

> Healthcare hospitality consulting. Medicality Consultants brings five-star hotel service standards into hospitals and health systems to improve patient experience (HCAHPS / Press Ganey scores), employee satisfaction and retention, and hospital reputation.

- Founded by Jim Treadway, former President of Westin Hotels & Resorts North America, with physicians Michel Kliot MD, Kamal Singh MD, and Gerald Grant MD (Chair of Neurosurgery, Duke University).
- Approach: embedded within hospital operations; proactive issue resolution while patients are still in the building; serves ownership, patients, and employees equally.
- Based in Napa, California; serves hospitals across the United States. Phone: (206) 310-7772.
- Contact: https://medicalityconsultants.com/#contact
